# Own the Block v1.11.0

## Power-up gameplay and collectible cards

- Complete 30-card Attack, Defense and Utility system with authoritative START rewards, hidden category-only offers, inventory capacity/replacement/decline, Active cards, Reactions, trade consent, statuses, targeting and reconnect recovery.
- Original 2D artwork, three category backs and four rarity treatments.
- OB-4: ivory/pastel physical card shells, staggered float/shadows, pointer tilt/shimmer, selected lift/glow and finite particles. Keyboard and OS/game reduced motion are supported. Selection remains server-locked before reveal; no extra confirmation step or post-lock switching.

## Desktop hosting and reliability

- OB-1: repair unpackaged Vite-to-helper connection with an explicit fixed-origin, loopback-only development opt-in. Packaged origin rules remain strict.
- OB-2: prepare the pinned and verified cloudflared binary in both developer entry points. LAN remains available when Online preparation fails; binary integrity is never bypassed.
- OB-3: hide the configured-server main-menu entry while preserving LAN/Online Host and Join.
- Includes the previously merged PR #27 reliability/refactor baseline: session/presence ownership, Host lifecycle/cancellation, server continuation, renderer resource/gesture boundaries and packaging parity regression coverage. Historical performance limitations remain as recorded.

## Compatibility and update

- Application version: **1.11.0**. Socket protocol: **16**. In-memory room snapshot schema: **14**. LAN discovery advertises protocol 16.
- v1.10.0 uses protocol 14 and is incompatible with these hosts/clients. Desktop guests must update both applications; browser guests use the matching Host-served client. Strict protocol handshakes reject mismatches with UPGRADE_REQUIRED.
- The minimum supported version is **1.11.0** for this protocol transition. The existing updater policy remains in force when its public feed is reachable.
- Finish active matches before updating. The authoritative Host holds rooms/sessions only in RAM; stopping/updating it ends its matches permanently. There is no database migration or hosted gameplay service.
- Windows publishes the Squirrel update feed. Unsigned macOS clients download/verify the DMG and require manual replacement.

## Validation and known limitations

The Product Owner explicitly authorized merge and stable release publication with unperformed manual tests recorded. This is release authorization, not manual UAT PASS. Automated CI, release quality, all three distribution targets, packaged runtime/Host/artwork/audio/budget proofs and asset checksums must succeed before publication. Detailed evidence: project-document/releases/V1_11_0_RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md.

- Windows x64, macOS Intel and Apple Silicon installers are **unsigned**; macOS is **not notarized**. Windows SmartScreen/macOS Gatekeeper may require the user's usual explicit handling for unsigned apps.
- Human-paced full-match/Power-up balance review, physical second-device LAN and independent-network guests, real macOS device use and installed v1.10.0→v1.11.0 upgrade acceptance remain **NOT RUN** for this release. Automated same-machine/native and CI checks do not replace them.
- Physical high-refresh/other-GPU performance and native renderer suspend/recovery remain unverified or blocked by the historical reproduction limits. Headless picker frame samples are not physical GPU FPS.
- Quick Tunnel remains temporary personal/testing connectivity with no uptime guarantee; real-world DNS/readiness latency can vary. No signing, release-platform or cloud-server architecture was changed.
